Ramesh has laid out breakfast: aloo parathas, curd and pickle.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Ramesh, before breakfast: does the estate office work on Sundays, and when does the dhobi come this week? I must settle the file on Monday and the bill on Saturday.

typed_records.speaker: Ramesh
typed_records.words: Office band hai aaj, sir, Monday ko aap aayenge toh kholenge. Dhobi kal subah aayega, ek din pehle aa raha hai is hafte.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Very good, Ramesh. Then breakfast at seven, and after it I shall walk in the garden while the air is clear. Keep the dhobi’s bill ready for tomorrow, and let me see it before he leaves.
